sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict confirmed_exact: position confirmed at this residue. validation_level surface_only -> detected_only (paper reports surface: not_reported, function: not_reported). Paper (PMID 31769408): "The HA-tag sequence is inserted between amino acids G284 and I285 by means of a 7aa long linker (linker-HA-tag: ISAYGIT-YPYDVPDYA).". Audit note: Mouse HCN2 (O88703, 863 aa; 'Residue numbering hereafter refers to mouse HCN2'). Alignment IPVDYIFLIVEKG|IDSEV maps mouse G284|I285 to human G311|I312 (offset +27), so the row's 311 is right. BUT the HA tag is never used: no anti-HA staining anywhere; membrane localization was EGFP/CellMask colocalization and currents came from untagged mHCN2 in pCI. validation_level surface_only is unsupported; tolerance only (construct expressed).] L4 explicitly names the junction as between G284 and I285 with a 7-aa linker and states the tag is extracellular. The canonical 889-aa sequence has K at positions 284-285 (intracellular, 264-289); a Python search for GI in extracellular spans finds exactly one match at canonical positions 311-312 (ECL2, 309-324), consistent with a 27-residue N-terminal offset between the paper's isoform and the canonical sequence. The junction at 311 is 3 residues from the TM3 C-terminal boundary (308) and 13 residues from the TM4 N-terminal boundary (325), satisfying the ≥3-residue rule. ECL2 contains no cysteines and no NxS/T glycosylation sequons. PMC6894927 reports full-length HCN2 (in pEGFP-C1) with an HA-tag inserted between residues the paper calls G284 and I285 via a 7-aa linker (ISAYGIT-YPYDVPDYA), described as extracellular. The paper uses a shorter isoform/mouse-HCN2 numbering that is 27 residues shorter at the N-terminus than the canonical 889-aa human sequence; the only GI motif in an extracellular region of the canonical sequence is at positions 311-312 (ECL2, 309-324), confirming the junction is our G311-I312. Python search confirmed: seq[310]='G', seq[311]='I', offset=311-284=27.

sources.claim: The HA-tag sequence is inserted between amino acids G284 and I285 by means of a 7aa long linker (linker-HA-tag: ISAYGIT-YPYDVPDYA).
